itens.trecho: Um bom filme romântico, ainda que por vezes seja demasiado açucarado. Este filme há muito tempo que se transformou num dos mais clássicos do cinema romântico, mas parece que o público tem pouco apreço ou paciência para filmes românticos, especialmente se são muito longos e lentos.

"Hana" (Juliette Binoche) volunteers to remain in war-torn Italy to look after her badly burnt patient. Who is he? Well nobody knows. All he recalls is that he came from England and that some time ago he was married.

Also remembered for a rare full frontal scene involving Kristin Scott Thomas' hairy triangle, The English Patient serves as a poignant critique of how nationalism and colonial borders dismantle human connection. The desert’s "mapless" freedom offers a romantic sanctuary, yet this ideal is ultimately crushed by the rigid, lethal identities imposed by WWII.
